name: beluchis-kitchen-bridge
description: Standalone in-restaurant bridge: polls the Beluchis website and auto-prints new orders to a network thermal printer.

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node -e "const{readdirSync}=require('node:fs'),{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');for(const f of readdirSync('lib').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.mjs'))){execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check','lib/'+f]);console.log('ok lib/'+f)}"
